Flagster Craftsmanship

BUILT FOR WALLS THAT DON'T DO BORING

Most online flags are thin, translucent nylon that shreds after a month. We engineered Flagster tapestries with dense 180GSM polyester canvas, laser-cut hems, and reinforced brass grommets that last for years.

4 × Brass Grommets

Precision-pressed eyelets on all 4 corners for effortless hanging with pushpins or command hooks.

130cm × 90cm Size

The golden wall ratio (~4.3 × 3.0 ft). Fills empty spaces over beds, desks, and DJ tables perfectly.

Machine Washable

Wash on cold, iron on low with a cloth barrier. Creases drop out in seconds.

Zero Chemical Smells

Eco-friendly aqueous sublimation inks. Odorless, hypoallergenic, and pet-friendly.
